evaluation_rubric.criterion: Does the implementation satisfy 100% of functional requirements and edge cases? Scores: 0 (Broken/Incomplete), 5 (Partial bugs), 10 (Fully correct).
Are there SQL injection, SSRF, memory leaks, or unvalidated inputs? Scores: 0 (Critical CVE), 5 (Minor security warnings), 10 (Zero vulnerabilities).
Is time complexity optimal? Are DB queries vectorized and connection-pooled? Scores: 0 (O(N^2) or unbounded memory), 5 (Suboptimal), 10 (Optimal O(N)).
Are type signatures strict? Is error handling explicit with zero empty catches? Scores: 0 (Untyped/No docs), 5 (Partial types), 10 (Production grade).
